content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Syracuse

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate degree, or high school diploma shapes your required experience hours. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can verify your qualifications before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, interact with active certified practitioners, and build the formal education PMI requires. Our structured curriculum covers the PMBOK® Guide and exam domains across multiple sessions designed for working professionals.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, register with PMI and submit your formal PMP application. Provide documentation of your education and project experience, then pay the PMI exam fee. Granite PM Academy can guide you through the application process to ensure accuracy and completeness.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, strategy sessions, and targeted reviews—to build confidence. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center when you're ready. Sit for the computer-based PMP exam and demonstrate mastery of project-management knowledge and skills.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, commit to the standard 3-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, and professional activities. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to help you stay current and fulfill your maintenance requirements effortlessly.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
